other_failure_modes.name: Missing feature scaling for Neural Network
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains a deep neural network on tabular data without applying any standard scaling or normalisation (e.g., StandardScaler) to the numeric features. Passing large, unscaled values directly into unscaled linear layers typically causes exploding gradients and NaN outputs, which leads to execution failure during metric calculation (ValueError: Input contains NaN).

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect datetime parsing unit
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies `pd.to_datetime` to numeric Unix timestamp columns without specifying the unit (e.g., `unit='s'`). By default, pandas interprets numeric values as nanoseconds, converting valid timestamps into dates clustering around 1970. This results in useless extracted temporal features and destroys the original timestamp values.

summary: The agent implements an extensive preprocessing pipeline and a TabularNet model for the classification task. However, it fails to scale the numeric features before feeding them to the neural network, triggering exploding gradients that cause execution failure. Furthermore, the agent hardcodes the ID column as 'id' (breaking the submission file format) and improperly parses Unix timestamps by defaulting to nanoseconds, corrupting the temporal features.
